svg.text: Unit cards behind terrain — one card per unit, every unit text a row of it (Map 3D §6am, CE-4582; house style)
Scope: the cards, place labels and the Units layer rows. The 3-D scene is context (unchanged). Grey notes are not drawn by the app.
A — the 3-D map, Units ▸ Hide labels behind terrain ON (the default)
① Bravo 2-1 beyond the ridge: the card is CUT at the ridge line (per pixel) · the waypoint text WP 3 beyond it is hidden the same way
② Bravo 1-2 behind the building: only the part above the roof shows — frame, bar and stress row cut together, never one piece alone
③ Alpha 1-1 in a wood: trees never hide a card (§6am D-3, step 2) · ④ the selected unit: always whole, on top (as its body, §6ak D-7)
B — the squad leader's ONE card, every row on
no picture on this node yet
each row keeps ITS layer and shows only while that layer is on
AND the card's own layer (Units ▸ Labels) is on — no orphan card
C — a member: what was about HIM is on HIS card
were drawn at the member as free text by the LEADER's gizmo;
now a row of the member's own card (Squad command layer)
D — Map ▸ Layers, the Units group (rows unchanged except the NEW one)
Hide labels behind terrain — ON by default; OFF = today's cards on top (M13).
Entities now also hides the 3-D BODIES (and they are not pickable) — today
it hides only the gizmo symbols; the bodies are always drawn.
Labels off ⇒ no card at all, even with Mind state on (today: a card holding
only the stress rows — the orphan card).
E — the same view with the toggle OFF: every card on top, as today (M13)
